name: Generic thermal camera (InfiRay format)
notes: For thermal cameras that send the InfiRay frame: the camera's own picture over raw temperatures, twice as tall as the sensor (e.g. 256x384 for 256x192). Topdon TC001 and InfiRay P2 Pro are said to use it; tested only with a TOOLTOP T256. The camera opens at its largest resolution, which for these cameras is the one with temperatures. A camera that sends something else shows its picture with "No temperature data".
